    (N : Namespace) (p : bbolt.BFile) (w : bbolt.WDb) (hok : bbolt.wdbOK w) (hL : ∀ (b : Loc) (l :
    Nat), w.ms = some (b, l) → 8192 ≤ l) : ⊢ inv (bbolt.pagesN N) (bbolt.pagesInv B p) -∗ ghostVar
    B.cur (Qp.half 1).half w.C -∗ ghostVar B.fl (Qp.half 1) w.fl -∗ ghostVar B.map (Qp.half 1) w.ms
    -∗ ghostVar B.map (Qp.half 1).half w.ms -∗ ghostVar B.mtok 1 () -∗ ghostVar B.wv (Qp.half 1)
    bbolt.wIdle -∗ ghostVar B.out (Qp.half 1) false -∗ bbolt.metaCellsQ (Qp.half 1).half w.ms w.C -∗
    bbolt.wCells w.ms w.W -∗ Fs.osMeta p.ino (DFrac.own 1) w.m ={⊤}=∗ bbolt.closeMapRes p w.ms ∗
    ghostVar B.cur (Qp.half 1).half w.C ∗ ghostVar B.fl (Qp.half 1) w.fl ∗ ghostVar B.map (Qp.half
    1) none ∗ ghostVar B.map (Qp.half 1).half none ∗ ghostVar B.mtok 1 () ∗ ghostVar B.wv (Qp.half
    1) bbolt.wIdle ∗ ghostVar B.out (Qp.half 1) false

theorem bbolt.mapFields_join2 [ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt] [Fs.FsSemOk] [hos : HasExt Fs.fsExt] (db :
    Loc) (ms : bbolt.MapSt) : bbolt.mapFields db (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) ms ∗ bbolt.mapFields db
    (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) ms ⊣⊢ bbolt.mapFields db (DFrac.own 1) ms

theorem bbolt.pt_join {V : Type} [TypedPointsto V] (l : Loc) (v : V) : typedPointsto l v (DFrac.own
    (Qp.half 1)) ∗ typedPointsto l v (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) ⊢ typedPointsto l v (DFrac.own 1)

theorem bbolt.close_gather [ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt] [Fs.FsSemOk] [hos : HasExt Fs.fsExt] (B :
    bbolt.BNs) (N : Namespace) (p : bbolt.BFile) (w : bbolt.WDb) (b : Loc) (L : Nat) (hok :
    bbolt.wdbOK w) (hms : w.ms = some (b, L)) (hL : 8192 ≤ L) : ⊢ inv (bbolt.pagesN N)
    (bbolt.pagesInv B p) -∗ ghostVar B.cur (Qp.half 1).half w.C -∗ ghostVar B.fl (Qp.half 1) w.fl -∗
    ghostVar B.map (Qp.half 1) (some (b, L)) -∗ ghostVar B.map (Qp.half 1).half (some (b, L)) -∗
    ghostVar B.mtok 1 () -∗ ghostVar B.wv (Qp.half 1) bbolt.wIdle -∗ ghostVar B.out (Qp.half 1)
    false -∗ bbolt.metaCellsQ (Qp.half 1).half (some (b, L)) w.C -∗ bbolt.wCells (some (b, L)) w.W
    ={⊤}=∗ (∃ vf, Fs.cellsR b 0 L vf) ∗ ghostVar B.cur (Qp.half 1).half w.C ∗ ghostVar B.fl (Qp.half
    1) w.fl ∗ ghostVar B.map (Qp.half 1) none ∗ ghostVar B.map (Qp.half 1).half none ∗ ghostVar
    B.mtok 1 () ∗ ghostVar B.wv (Qp.half 1) bbolt.wIdle ∗ ghostVar B.out (Qp.half 1) false

theorem bbolt.metaR.congr_simp [ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt] [hos : HasExt Fs.fsExt] (B B✝ : bbolt.BNs)
    (e_B : B = B✝) (db db✝ : Loc) (e_db : db = db✝) (p p✝ : bbolt.BFile) (e_p : p = p✝) :
    bbolt.metaR B db p = bbolt.metaR B✝ db✝ p✝

theorem bbolt.pt_split {V : Type} [TypedPointsto V] (l : Loc) (v : V) : typedPointsto l v (DFrac.own
    1) ⊢ typedPointsto l v (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) ∗ typedPointsto l v (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1))

    C.hwm
